notes: A white card on a black page shows the MCP logo and 'Authorization Required: This client wants to connect to your MCP server'. The requesting client appears only as a raw UUID in a monospace box labelled Client Application, so the user cannot tell which app is asking. A 'What happens next?' box explains a redirect to authenticate with the upstream provider. A single black 'Continue to Authentication' button ends the card, with no Deny option and no permissions listed. This is the MCP example server's page.
